changelog:
PATCH. 
 Floating subtitles: restrained captions below voice orb, stays within 3 lines, gentle changes, no bottom-edge crowding. Enable: Voice → Voice Reply → Standard TTS → Floating subtitle overlay. Thanks @lone-baggie.

Music resume remembers cover, song, position after pause or source loss. Seek, jump, track changes sync player and lyrics. Screensaver stays away during lyrics. Path: Settings → Interaction → Media & Playback → Detailed metadata.

Lyrics instrumental breaks show ♪ display, longer breaks more marks, ending settles cleanly. English lines, rap, narrow screens scroll smoother. Portrait title/artist separate lines. Karaoke adds AMLL word-synced lyrics, searches AMLL + LRCLIB + QQ Music, considers title/artist/album/duration. Results faster, less studio/live confusion.

Sendspin multi-room: responds to small delays earlier, less speed oscillation. Auto-reconnect on overloaded/silent devices. Smart echo cancellation for wake during playback: Settings → Voice → Microphone → Echo cancellation.

Health Steward stepped rest: groups state bursts, brief screensaver pauses dashboard, long absence rests animations/video. Off-screen cards wait to draw. Dual-page: one settles before other loads. Same-address panes preserved. Screensaver no longer jumps over preparing pages. ERR_UNSAFE_PORT fixed. Cache clear refreshes both panes. Separate toggles: Entity stream scheduling, Chunked card rendering, Dormant load reduction, Entity filtering. Path: Settings → Browser → WebView Health Steward.

Interaction home reorganized: Media & Playback, Displays & Scenes, Intercom & Calls, Entities & Shortcuts. Landscape prioritizes music, portrait consistent. Small screen: 2-line descriptions, drag to read, 2-tap expand. 6 languages aligned.

Update page: clear download/confirm/network states, Retry action, button labels resize. Distinguishes new release from rebuilt same-version. Portal devices: Shizuku/root/adb may still be required #164.

Portal system bar control: visible, hide top, or hide both. Path: Mod Store → Devices → Portal Support 1.3.0. Thanks @realroywalker #156.

Ambient sound: Baby cry → Noise, warns false alerts. Voiceprint recording: normal volume/shorter speech accepted. Mod footer adapts width. Root page explains optional nature. Preview cards no longer covered by Voice Stats. Music button/position consistent after pause/resume. Languages aligned.
